column1: # Spacing classes of Korean words (한글 맞춤법 제41–50항). G spaces every word except where a row says
# it attaches. Particles (P nodes) and the copula always attach to the word before them.
#   lemma   the word (N or V lemma)
#   kind    dep (의존 명사) | counter (단위 명사) | suffix (접미사) | aux (보조 용언) | prefix
#   attach  never: always spaced (제42항 의존 명사, 제47항 보조 용언 원칙)
#           after-noun: attached after a noun, spaced after an adnominal (뿐, 만큼, 대로: 너뿐, 할 뿐)
#           after-digit: attached after a digit, spaced after a word (3개, 세 개; 제43항 붙임)
#           always: always attached (접미사; -어지다, -어하다 are one word)
#           next: a prefix attached to the next word
